pod.resumed: Report: Welcome back. Setup continues where you left off.
pod.creatingDone: Report: Project created and checked. Everything is in place.
pod.creatingDoneLater: Report: Server set up and checked. A Project can come later.
pod.readyLater: Report: Puppet Master is set up. A Project can be created whenever you like.
pod.alert: Alert: That did not work. The note on screen says what to do next.
pod.alertField: Alert: That entry was not accepted. Check it and try again.
ops: Report: Confirmed. Ready for the next step.

screens.welcome: Report: Pod 042 will assist with setup. It takes a few minutes, and every choice can be changed later.
screens.look: Proposal: Pick the look you like best. It can be changed later.
screens.where: Query: Where should the work happen? Most people choose this computer.
screens.cRoute: Report: Puppet Masters on your network appear here. Choose the one this device should use.
screens.cReview: Proposal: Check the name, then continue. The other computer will ask you to confirm.
screens.cPair: Proposal: Compare the two pictures. Continue only if they match.
screens.cReady: Report: Connection confirmed. This device can now use your Puppet Master.
screens.sKind: Query: What kind of computer will the Server be? It keeps working while this device sleeps.
screens.sWait: Report: Standing by. The Server appears here by itself once Puppet Master runs on it.
screens.sConfirm: Proposal: Give the Server a name you will recognise later.
screens.sReady: Report: Server ready. Other devices can join it with this code, now or later.
screens.rSource: Query: Where is the backup? Nothing on this computer is replaced without asking.
screens.rUnlock: Report: The recovery phrase is used once and never saved.
screens.rPick: Proposal: Choose the copy to bring back. The newest is usually the right one.
screens.rPreview: Analysis: This is everything that comes back. Nothing changes until you confirm.
screens.rDone: Report: Restore complete. AI accounts need a quick sign-in.
screens.begin: Query: How should your Project begin? A Project keeps one thing you are making.
screens.exFolder: Report: The folder is only read. Nothing in it changes until the Project is created.
screens.name: Proposal: Use words you will recognise later.
screens.like: Query: Reuse the setup of a Project you already trust, or start fresh?
screens.onlineSignin: Report: Puppet Master only asks for access to the Project you choose.
screens.onlineService: Query: Where should the online copy live? GitHub is free and common.
screens.onlineDetails: Proposal: Check the name the online copy will use. The suggestion is fine.
screens.exRepos: Proposal: Choose the Project to bring in. Only that one is copied.
screens.safe: Report: Every version is saved on this computer. Online copies and backups are optional.
screens.away: Query: Should your Puppet Master answer when you are away from home? This can change any time.
screens.review: Analysis: Nothing has been created yet. Check each line, then create it in one step.
screens.creating: Report: Creating your Project. The window can close; the work continues.
screens.protect: Proposal: One sign-in and one test, and your backup is protected.
screens.ai: Query: Which AI should power Puppet Master? An account you already have works.
screens.aiAll: Report: Every supported AI is listed here. Search to find one quickly.
screens.aiNone: Report: No AI account yet is fine. Pick whichever kind suits you.
screens.free: Analysis: Free models suit lighter tasks. Their limits can change without notice.
screens.ready: Report: Setup complete. Pod 042 remains on standby.
screens.nasFind: Report: Looking for storage devices on your network. Nothing is changed.
screens.nasIdentity: Proposal: Check this picture matches the one your device shows.
screens.nasKey: Query: Which key should Puppet Master use? A key replaces the password.
screens.nasSignin: Report: The password is needed once, only to add your key.
screens.nasInstall: Report: Setting up the secure connection. Stand by.
screens.nasPmpair: Proposal: Compare the pictures, then approve this computer.
screens.nasFolder: Query: Which folder holds the Project's files?
screens.nasSmb: Report: Your sign-in is kept in the system keychain, not in Puppet Master.
screens.nasNfs: Proposal: Choose the share. Puppet Master checks that it can read it.
screens.nasMounted: Query: Which drive holds the Project? These are the drives this computer already shows.
